test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some printers are coolers.

No cooler is a telephone.

All machines are telephones.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some printers are machines.

II. No machine is a cooler.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a21b03557e69d1f692735099b13c1a35a461296b0e105cd90a68d14b59f39ae8.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some printers are machines → False (As Some printers are coolers and All machines are telephones and No cooler is a telephone so, Some printers are machines is false)

II. No machine is a cooler → True (As All machines are telephones and No cooler is a telephone so, No machine is a cooler is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows".**
